sections.title: General Return Policy
content: Hariram's Pure Cow Ghee products are not eligible for return after delivery.
Food products cannot be accepted back due to hygiene and food safety requirements.
Customers are requested to purchase carefully before placing an order.

sections.title: Damaged or Defective Products
content: Customers may report damaged or defective products such as broken containers, leakage, broken safety seals, manufacturing defects, or incorrect products supplied.

sections.title: Reporting a Quality Concern
content: Complaints should be reported within 48 hours of delivery.

Customers should provide the order number, contact details, photographs & videos of the product, packaging, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, and shipping box (if applicable), along with a description of the issue.

sections.title: Investigation Process
content: Each complaint is investigated individually.

Hariram's may review photographs, verify batch records, inspect quality records, consult the quality team, coordinate with courier partners, request additional information, or arrange product collection for examination if required.

sections.title: Refund Eligibility
content: Refunds are not automatic.
Refunds may be approved only when Hariram's confirms a manufacturing defect, transit damage attributable to Hariram's responsibility, or supply of an incorrect product.
The outcome will be based on the investigation and available evidence.

sections.title: Situations Where Refunds Will Not Be Approved
content: Change of mind
Taste preference
Natural variations in colour, aroma or texture
Incorrect order placed by the customer
Incorrect delivery information provided by the customer
Complaints raised after the reporting period
Improper storage after delivery
Damage caused after delivery

sections.title: Refund Method
content: Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method.
Banks and payment providers may take 5–10 business days to complete the refund.

sections.title: Order Cancellation
content: Orders may be cancelled before dispatch.
Orders cannot normally be cancelled after dispatch.
If Hariram's is unable to fulfil an order, a full refund will be issued.
